How to check which services you accessed through Apple ID and Google, and not lose access to them

From July 6, Russian websites and applications are required to remove the "Sign in with Google/Apple" buttons. The accounts themselves are not deleted, but access to them can be lost.

To prevent this from happening, you need to find the profiles created with Apple ID and Google, and add new ways to log in to them:
🍏 For Apple ID

On iPhone, iPad, or Mac, go to "Settings" → your name → "Sign in with Apple".

Here you can see all the applications and services that you accessed through Apple ID, as well as the substitute emails from the "Hide email" feature - save these addresses, you can use them to log in as well.
🔎 For Google Account

From any device and browser, go to myaccount.google.com/connections.

Here you can see all the applications and services where login was set up through Google.

Now log in to the necessary services through Apple/Google and add alternative login methods, such as by phone.

Good morning from the North Pacific Ocean as we make our way from Seattle to Alaska.

I woke up at 2:00 a.m. with a heart full of gratitude - for my family and for the wonderful people who have joined us for this conference aboard this magnificent ship. By 3:30 a.m., I found myself working out in the ship’s gym, where I often reflect on the times in which we live and the direction our world is heading. This morning was no different.

I am also deeply thankful for this remarkable group of speakers, each of whom I regard as an outstanding teacher of God’s Word and a living reflection of His character.

Truthfully, with speakers of this caliber, I would much rather sit, listen, and learn than stand and teach.

A day at sea is also a day of reflection.

For me, as many of you know, in light of recent events, the heaviness and sadness I carry on this semiquincentennial birthday of America are even greater. In 1948, there were great Americans who understood the magnitude of that historic moment and did everything they could to help the newborn - and only - Jewish state.

Even the legendary Frank Sinatra played his part. In 1948, he reportedly slipped out the back of a New York nightclub carrying a paper bag filled with one million dollars in cash to pay a ship captain for a critical, embargo-breaking shipment of munitions destined for Israel.

At the time, the United States had imposed a general arms embargo on the Middle East. Although it officially applied to all parties, it left the newly established State of Israel desperately short of weapons while neighboring Arab armies continued receiving arms from other sources. Yet the Lord always raises up men and women who recognize the significance of the hour and have the courage to act on their convictions.

Even now, as we face growing hostility toward Israel, it is worth reflecting on how extraordinary this relationship truly is. Here are two nations with no shared border, no meaningful economic dependence, and not even a common language - yet for decades they have been uniquely connected. No obvious national self-interest brought them together in the beginning. Rather, something deep within the American spirit has long been drawn to the story of the Jewish people and their return to their ancestral homeland.

And here I am, aboard an American cruise ship, sailing toward God’s breathtaking creation in Alaska - not only to behold His magnificent handiwork, but also surrounded by nearly 700 like-minded believers who understand the significance of the times and seasons in which we live.

Even if political leaders change course, pursue profit in the wrong places, or make deals with some of America’s greatest enemies, the saints gathered here understand that in these last days courage is a rare commodity - one that God expects, requires, and calls His people to demonstrate.

At times, standing for the truth may make us feel as though we are standing alone. Elijah felt exactly that way. Yet the Lord gently corrected him, reminding him that He had preserved a faithful remnant of 7,000 in Israel who had not bowed the knee to Baal (1 Kings 19:18). The same God who preserved a remnant then is preserving one today.

God has never needed the majority to accomplish His purposes. He has always worked through a faithful remnant. Our calling is not to be popular, but to be faithful - to speak the truth in love (Ephesians 4:15), contend earnestly for the faith (Jude 3), and leave the results to Him.

Hours, days, and even years of advocating for Israel ultimately mean very little if they are detached from the Word of God, the plan of God, and the love of God displayed through our precious Messiah, Yeshua. Israel matters because God says it matters. Our convictions must always be rooted in Scripture, never merely in politics or emotion.

I cannot wait to share, toward the end of this cruise, my new message, “Certainly Not!” - God’s answer to the doubts, distortions, and false teachings surrounding His plans and purposes for Israel.

Happy Birthday, America.

❗️ XRP price forms multi-month falling wedge near $1 support as liquidations mount 

📣 According to data from cryptonews price, XRP price dropped from around $1.07 on June 25 to $1.01 on June 26, extending its year-to-date decline to more than 40%. The decline accelerated as a $10.8 billion crypto options expiry triggered heavy volatility across digital assets and forced a wave of long liquidations.

⚠️ At the same time, sentiment surrounding the XRP ecosystem weakened after decentralized finance protocol Strobe Finance abruptly announced it would shut down operations.

🔖 The daily chart shows XRP trading at the lower edge of a falling wedge that has contained price action for almost a year. The pattern has compressed between descending resistance and gradually declining support, with the token now sitting close to the wedge’s lower boundary near $1.00.

🔗 Momentum indicators remain weak. The MACD has stayed below its signal line with histogram bars still in negative territory, while the Aroon indicator continues to favor sellers after Aroon Down climbed back toward 100 and Aroon Up remained subdued. Together, the indicators suggest bears still control the short-term trend even as XRP price approaches a historically important support zone.
